question: Should OpenClaw retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` now and require `imsg` 0.11.1 at iMessage startup, accepting doctor and binary-upgrade actions for existing users?
rationale: This intentionally converts previously accepted persisted config and older binaries into fail-closed upgrade states; source and tests can validate mechanics, but they cannot choose the compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof covers doctor migration, old-version recovery messaging, and one-turn split-send delivery.

options.title: Defer retirement
options.body: Keep the current config and client-side fallback until maintainers are ready to require the binary and config upgrade together.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof covers doctor migration, old-version recovery messaging, and one-turn split-send delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice primarily concerns the supported `imsg` release floor and operator upgrade policy around that dependency.
